newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STEADY ON DLR, SOFTER ON CROSSES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STEADY ON DLR, SOFTER ON CROSSES.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was trading steadily at its previous levels against the U.S. dollar but was quoted softer on European currencies and the rand on Thursday morning.
Dealers anticipated very little trade during the day and said the local unit was likely to remain stable until market closure.
"We don't expect much to happen today. It looks like it's going to be a quiet day," commented one.

At around 0730 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted unchanged from Wednesday's 11,3775/3875 against the U.S. dollar but was weaker versus sterling at 19,1045/1100 compared to 19,0455/1150, tracking an easier U.S. dollar overseas.
It was at 6,3530/3555 from 6,3485/3650 against the mark and at 2,5000/5035 on the rand from 2,4975/5075.
